case_evidence.description: Pinned frozen Python 1.2 public src/eyetrajectoriespy/nonlinear_plotting.py::plot_rqa_metric_mean_bootstrap inspected. Native R adds optional strict_source_record=TRUE without changing the original function's default R numeric and graphic return.

Bounded validated finite native R numeric source records and data.frames with declared fields, explicit metric/statistic names and strict source NumPy bin counts. Python pandas/dataclass runtime and arbitrary supplied Matplotlib Axes or exception classes are excluded.

Published source RQA mean percentile bootstrap errorbar, ordered source metrics, asymmetric yerr, capsize=4, marker=o, rotated-right tick labels 30 degrees and scientific title/unit. The author wrote direct frozen Python 1.2 public Matplotlib artist differential tests, along with native numerical, singleton, malformed-domain and legacy-default regression cases. Exact-head CI success has not been observed.

Source semantic checks fail closed for invalid strict flags, nonfinite scientific geometry, incorrect metrics, impossible source intervals and source bin types. Exact Python TypeError, IndexError, ValueError, KeyError identity is not implemented in R.

Default R plotting output and invisible numerical source geometry preserved. Strict mode returns typed native etr_nonlinear_scientific_artist_record of ordered Matplotlib scientific coordinates/axes rather than live Python matplotlib.axes.Axes or pixel/raster identity.
Precomputed RQA population-level whole-unit bootstrap mean and percentile uncertainty, not newly bootstrapped or redefined.
